channel.title: Workplace Leader Weekly Agenda
channel.description: A weekly executive agenda for workplace leaders: Microsoft 365, identity and AI signals that pass the budget, risk and friction gate.

item.title: Default-On AI vs. Deliberate Control
item.description: Microsoft switches AI capability and spend on by default in the next ten weeks: Claude in Swiss and EU tenants on 9 December, metered Copilot experiences from January, pay-as-you-go Copilot Business billing in Q1 2027. Decide every default before its date, with a named owner.
